data_provenance.notes: All vendors, invoices and payment records are generated from a fixed seed. No real people, companies or bank details are included.

generator.reproducibility: verified - identical row counts and SHA-256 hashes across two runs

anomaly_distribution.quantity_mismatch: 160 invoices (8.0% - 80 partial delivery, 80 exceed PO qty)
anomaly_distribution.duplicate_invoices: 100 invoices (5.0% - 50 duplicate invoice number, 50 same invoice resubmission)
anomaly_distribution.tax_vendor_arithmetic_errors: 60 invoices (3.0% - 15 closed vendor, 15 tax mismatch, 15 line sum mismatch, 15 date before PO)

routing.PROCESS_OWNER: High-value price exceptions (over $500) and workflow overrides
routing.APPROVER: Standard price variances within department limits
routing.OPERATIONS_ANALYST: Missing receipts, arithmetic errors, date anomalies, tax discrepancies
